verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents first-party natural-language interfaces. Cortex Analyst lets users ask questions in natural language and get answers without writing SQL, and it is also exposed as a REST API. Cortex Code is an AI coding agent integrated into Snowflake for data engineering workflows, and CoWork/CoCo are marketed as 'ask anything / build anything' agentic entry points. Missing for 10: documentation showing natural-language control of administrative operations (warehouses, roles, sharing) beyond querying and data engineering, in-depth docs for Cortex Code and CoWork beyond one-line descriptions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
